instruction: Using Apple Notes, make a new note with the title "Reading Queue" inside the "Ideas" folder.
reference_command:
cat > /tmp/memo_auto_add.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
file="$1"

cat > "$file" <<'TXT'
Reading Queue

TXT
EOF

chmod +x /tmp/memo_auto_add.sh
EDITOR=/tmp/memo_auto_add.sh memo notes --folder "Ideas" --add
